articles.title: What ‘Backrooms’ and ‘Obsession’ Really Say About the State of Cinema
articles.teaser: The two internet horror juggernauts point to a new paradigm in moviegoing.

articles.title: FORECAST: In the ‘Backrooms’ of the Box Office
articles.teaser: Backrooms and Obsession on track to reshape the summer box office as we know it.

articles.title: ‘Obsession’s Second Weekend Hold Overshadows Star Wars
articles.teaser: The Mandalorian and Grogu opened on top, as predicted, but the runaway success of Obsession exceeded everyone’s forecast.

articles.title: FORECAST: ‘Mandalorian’ to Rule Memorial Day as Box Office Jedi
articles.teaser: Star Wars goes through the motions, while Obsession hints at one of the most impressive holds for horror since The Ring.

articles.title: ‘Michael’ Brings the 80s Back to the Box Office
articles.teaser: Michael reclaims the top spot in its fourth weekend, a holding pattern unheard of in the post-streaming era.

articles.title: FORECAST: ‘Michael’ to Reclaim Top Spot in Fourth Weekend
articles.teaser: In true 1980s box office fashion, Michael is near-guaranteed a miraculous return to the top, with Obsession on track to break out.

articles.title: FORECAST: ‘Mortal Kombat II’ Goes Up Against Meryl and Michael
articles.teaser: In an unlikely three-way battle, we surprised ourselves with where we landed in this week’s predictions, and it’s gonna get bloody. Hear us out.

articles.title: 2026 Summer Forecast
articles.teaser: Something in the lineup feels like a warning. Our read on the summer slate — plus the ranked top 10, possible breakouts, and one intentional omission.

articles.title: FORECAST: ‘The Devil Wears Prada 2’ Suits Up for Summer
articles.teaser: Summer kicks off the way it used to — with a real, true tentpole. Prada 2 arrives without a counter-programmer, but it won’t be soaring up there alone. Michael holds with Passion-of-the-Christ legs.

articles.title: FORECAST: ‘Michael’ to Dethrone ‘Mario’ as Box Office King
articles.teaser: Michael is poised to surpass Straight Outta Compton’s record for biggest opening for a musical biopic, but there’s a more indicative biopic in the cards: The Passion of the Christ’s $83.8 million opening is the floor.

articles.title: ‘Mario’ Holds, ‘Hail Mary’ Enters Rare Territory, ‘Lee’ Crones
articles.teaser: We came in close on Super Mario Galaxy again — over by about $1 million on our forecast. Project Hail Mary enters rare company, and Lee Cronin’s Mummy lands on the soft side.

articles.title: FORECAST: Lee Cronin Battles Mario, Again
articles.teaser: Nothing too crazy happening this weekend. The holdovers continue to thrive, and a new horror film from Warner Bros shoots its shot ahead of the summer rush.

articles.title: ‘Mario’ Repeats, ‘Hail Mary’ Enters Rare Company
articles.teaser: Mario repeats at number one, Project Hail Mary crosses a rare milestone for an original sci-fi, and a few new platform releases test the waters.

articles.title: FORECAST: Holy Mario
articles.teaser: Super Mario Galaxy is poised to repeat at number one, with Project Hail Mary continuing its journey into the infinite. A Roman holiday may or may not happen, and Hoppers persists.
